model.name: OOSH-repo targeting via RepoRegistry key-allowlist
model.description: The diff/file tooling can target a DIFFERENT repo (e.g. the OOSH repo) safely, without hardcoding RawBin's root. The client sends a repo KEY (?repo=oosh), never an absolute path; a server-side allowlist (new Class RepoRegistry) maps the key to a configured absolute root, unknown key -> 400. GitApi's currently-hardcoded ROOT (shipped 7c9554494) is de-hardcoded to a per-request RepoRegistry.resolve(req.repo) seam that OPTS.cwd + safeRelPath read; /api/files, RbFileTree.setRepo, and the rb-diff-editor repo selector consume the same registry. Default remains rawbin=PROJECT_ROOT (R30.5 unaffected).
model.tronQuote: > TRON 2026-07-13 (R30.6.7): the diff tool must work on the OOSH repo, not just RawBin — target the OOSH repo safely.

discoverySource.note: R30.6 sub-feature (7/7): repo targeting for the diff editor. GitApi ROOT already shipped hardcoded (7c9554494) -> R30.6.7 is the clean de-hardcode to a resolve(repo) seam. Scenario-first; planner tasks T30.6.7. Fold into the in-flight GitApi build (server.ts:495), no retrofit.

model.crossRefNote: Lets the R30.6 diff editor (umbrella) operate on the OOSH repo. New Class RepoRegistry (0 existing, MINT-NEW) resolve/list = the security-critical key->abs allowlist shared by GitApi + files handler; new Method RbFileTree.setRepo on Class RbFileTree REUSE 0916d007-6af3-49ba-8f7e-aac32d5ded6a (the sole RbFileTree Class, 1 method; architect-confirmed). GitApi de-hardcodes ROOT->RepoRegistry.resolve seam. Open decision for PO/Tron: RepoRegistry-class (architect rec) vs GitApi.resolveRepoRoot.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The client supplies a repo KEY only (e.g. ?repo=oosh); the absolute path lives server-side in a RepoRegistry allowlist. A client-supplied absolute path is NEVER resolved.

RepoRegistry.resolve(key) returns the allowlisted absolute root for the key, else null; RepoRegistry.list() returns [{key,label}] for a repo picker. Allowlist config {rawbin:PROJECT_ROOT, oosh:<abs OOSH root>}.

GitApi's hardcoded ROOT is replaced by a per-request RepoRegistry.resolve(req.repo) seam that BOTH OPTS.cwd and safeRelPath read; branches/commits/fileAtRef run with cwd=resolvedRoot. Unknown ?repo -> 400.
safePath still applies WITHIN the resolved root (no '..', no leading '/', resolve(root,p).startsWith(root+sep)); read-only across all repos.

/api/files accepts optional ?repo=<key>; RbFileTree.setRepo(key) sets a repo attr + reloads (loadDir appends ?repo); rb-diff-editor exposes a repo selector from RepoRegistry.list() feeding loadSide/pickFile/pickRef.
?repo absent -> rawbin=PROJECT_ROOT; R30.5 and existing callers are unchanged.
